A locally executed standard-library checker reports 328 exact assertions and 750000 random point-pair comparisons; these do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The mean intrinsic distance is a canonical metric-measure invariant of a genus-two metric network. The complete positive-length cubic and sharp fixed-topology lower bound classify its unique optimum; a surprising majorization obstruction reveals a genuine failure of monotone geometric balancing. It is a natural continuous family, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or recomputation of an existing numeric table.
